sandbox.metaTitle: DaPay Sandbox — Digital Product Business Simulation
sandbox.metaDesc: Learn order workflows and margin calculations via DaPay Sandbox with a risk-free virtual balance separate from LIVE cash.
sandbox.heroTitle1: Simulate Selling Mobile Credit & Digital Products
sandbox.heroSubtitle: Practice ordering mobile credit, data packages, and PLN electricity tokens with a Virtual Sandbox Balance. Understand workflows and projected margins before committing real capital.
sandbox.heroMicroNote1: Free simulation • LIVE cash balance is not used
sandbox.heroMicroNote2: Sign up for a free account to activate the Sandbox and receive Rp 1,000,000 virtual balance.
sandbox.trustHighlight1Desc: Provided free to practice product transaction simulations.
sandbox.trustHighlight2Desc: Sandbox never touches your LIVE cash balance.
sandbox.trustHighlight3Desc: Switch to LIVE anytime using the exact same account credentials.
sandbox.previewSubtitle: Explore simulated wholesale prices and estimated retail counter markups.
sandbox.marginIllustrationBody: For example, on Telkomsel 10K Mobile Credit: Demo cost Rp 10,500 with sample counter selling price Rp 12,000 yields an estimated +Rp 1,500 margin per simulated transaction.
sandbox.marginDisclaimer: *Margin estimates are illustrative for business practice, not a guarantee of real profits.
sandbox.workflowSubtitle: From free demo activation to full real-world readiness.
sandbox.step1Desc: Sign up for free in 1 minute. Instantly receive Rp 1,000,000 virtual balance to test the system without real deposits.
sandbox.step2Desc: Simulate purchasing mobile credit, data packages, and PLN tokens to test numbers. Master instant order flows and margin calculations.
sandbox.step3Desc: Once you are confident with the platform, seamlessly switch to a LIVE Member using the exact same account.
sandbox.learningSubtitle: Build practical operational skills before serving real retail customers.
sandbox.benefit1Desc: Discover popular mobile credits, data quotas, and PLN token denominations favored by retail customers in Indonesia.
sandbox.benefit2Desc: Understand differences between wholesale demo prices and retail pricing to set healthy profit margins.
sandbox.benefit3Desc: Get hands-on experience entering phone numbers, checking bill inquiries, and verifying successful delivery states.
sandbox.benefit4Desc: Simulate Regular and Special tiers to clearly grasp cashback bonuses and referral commissions.
sandbox.importantNoticeBody: DaPay Sandbox is an educational simulation tool. Margin estimates are illustrative for practice and not a guarantee of real-world profits.
sandbox.comparisonSubtitle: Understand reward structures that align with DaPay business policies.
sandbox.regularDesc: Ideal for beginners who want to transact without monthly target quotas.
sandbox.regularFooter: Enjoy foundational transactions and referral commission opportunities.
sandbox.specialDesc: Designed for active counters seeking extra reward earnings per transaction.
sandbox.specialFooter: Transaction cashback is awarded in the form of reward Coins.
sandbox.faqSubtitle: Official answers regarding rules, virtual balances, and DaPay Sandbox operations.
sandbox.bottomTitle: Ready to Take the First Step in Your Digital Business?
sandbox.bottomSubtitle: Free simulation to experience how DaPay works. Activate using your DaPay account and virtual Sandbox balance.
sandbox.bottomDisclaimer: Requires a registered account with a verified email. Not available for Admin/Manager accounts.
